title: The Fighting King
setup: A black pawn stands right beside your king, with no bodyguard in sight.
hint: The king captures the way it moves: one square in any direction. Is the d4-pawn defended?
explanation:
## The Idea

The king is not only a piece to protect; it can fight too. The black pawn on d4 is one step away, and **nothing defends it**: the black king on e8 is four ranks away.

{{Kxd4}} takes it safely. Check first, always: a black pawn on d4 attacks c3 and e3, not the square your king stands on or the one it lands on.

A king may capture any piece beside it that nothing defends.
